system.description:
In order to cast this jutsu you must have a creature marked with the Sealing Art: Chakra Seal ninjutsu, that you cast.

You telepathically become aware of all creatures, objects and structures marked with Sealing Art: Chakra Seal and you reshape the seal on the triggering creature, in an attempt to divert the harmful effect.

Initiate a Clash check with the triggering creature. On a success, you teleport the harmful effect to another marked creature, object or structure within 1 mile of you. The target seal that had the harmful effect teleported to it, is dispelled. On a failure, you do not suffer the effects of a failed clash.

trigger.text: Reaction, which you take when a creature marked with the Sealed Art: Chakra Seal ninjutsu casts a jutsu that deals damage with an effect that is visible.
